map.随机语句按语料拼接：句子 = 从语料库等概率抽取一句；段落 = 连续抽取 n 句: Random text is stitched together from the corpus: a sentence = one sentence drawn uniformly at random from the corpus; a paragraph = n consecutive sentences drawn (n can be set from 3 to 8) and joined with periods; removing repeated sentences improves readability; the combination space = number of corpus sentences to the power of n, which suits placeholder copy, layout demos and writing inspiration.
map.📚 深度解析：随机句子/段落（内置语料）: 📚 Deep Dive: Random Sentence / Paragraph (built-in corpus)
map.占位文案：给设计稿填随机段落，先看排版再换真实内容。: Placeholder copy: fill a design mockup with random paragraphs to check the layout before swapping in real content.
map.排版演示：用长短不一的段落测试换行、缩进与字体。: Layout demo: use paragraphs of varying length to test line breaks, indentation and fonts.
map.写作灵感：随机取句触发思路，再据此扩写。: Writing inspiration: draw a random sentence to trigger an idea, then expand on it.
map.设段落数 2，工具从语料拼接出两段连贯文字，粘贴进原型即可看版式效果，后续替换为: Set the paragraph count to 2 and the tool stitches two coherent paragraphs from the corpus; paste them into the prototype to see the layout, then replace them with the final copy later.
map.由内置语料随机拼接，语义连贯但不构成完整原创作品，仅作占位与演示。: It is randomly stitched from a built-in corpus, so it reads coherently but does not constitute an original work, and it is only for placeholders and demos.
map.可按页面选项设句数或段数；具体以页面为准。: The sentence or paragraph count can be set through the page's options; the page is authoritative.
map.仅本地生成不上传，关闭即不留存。: Everything is generated locally with no upload, and nothing remains after you close the page.
map.随机句子/段落（内置语料）。数据分析工具，帮助快速处理与可视化数据。: Random sentences and paragraphs (built-in corpus). Data analysis tools that help you process and visualize data quickly.
